records.name: Cline Agents
records.one_liner: Public host-neutral agent loop with supplied models/tools, lifecycle hooks, streaming and in-memory snapshots; coding tools, storage and teams belong to core.

dims.loop: AgentRuntime run/continue/abort/snapshot/restore; sequential tools by default, adjacent explicitly parallel tools may overlap; iteration limit and cancellation.
dims.providers: @cline/llms gateway/model abstractions over AI SDK 7 providers, or a host-supplied model.
dims.tools: JSON Schema plus execution callback with cancellation/progress; no default coding toolbox. Approval-required calls deny if the host callback is absent.
dims.context: Host-controlled request preparation and history snapshots; no built-in full-product compaction/skills policy.
dims.state: In-memory conversation snapshots and restoration; no persistent store or crash replay in the bare package.
dims.safety: Tool enabled/autoApprove policy and host approval callback; no built-in OS confinement or coding-tool policy.
dims.extensibility: Before/after run/model/tool hooks and common events, with host-supplied tools and model configuration.
dims.multi_agent: No built-in team orchestration in this package; core adds delegation and team stores.
dims.surfaces: Direct public TypeScript import for custom hosts, including host-neutral contexts.
dims.observability: Lifecycle/stream events and optional model-layer telemetry; not a complete product tracing service.

key_insights: The experimental public package is genuinely separate from the integrated Cline applications.
A restored message snapshot is not a durable effect continuation.
Core, not agents, owns the default coding tools and team orchestration.

features_notes.plugins: Runtime hooks/extensions; full plugin distribution and services belong to core.
features_notes.otel: Model-layer integration is optional; callbacks remain the basic observation surface.
features_notes.approvals: Host callback is required when a tool needs approval; absent callback denies.

records.name: Cline SDK / Core
records.one_liner: Public coding-agent harness with sessions, default tools, MCP, plugins, teams and hub transports; @cline/sdk directly re-exports @cline/core.

dims.loop: ClineCore assembles the lower-level AgentRuntime with sessions, request preparation, default tools and local/hub/remote execution modes.
dims.providers: @cline/llms and AI SDK 7 adapters, with provider/model configuration supplied through the host.
dims.tools: Default coding tools/executors, MCP ingestion, approvals and explicit child tool/policy forwarding.
dims.context: Basic/agentic compaction with usage-aware request preparation; project rules, AGENTS.md, skills and workflow discovery.
dims.state: SQLite sessions, metadata/artifacts/team stores and file checkpoint transactions. Persistent chat resume, not established arbitrary effect replay.
dims.safety: Tool approvals and policy propagation; plugin worker/subprocess isolation is not an OS security sandbox.
dims.extensibility: Plugin tools, commands, rules, message builders, hooks and configuration; failure timeouts and thresholds.
dims.multi_agent: Spawned agents with forwarded hooks/tool policies plus team mailboxes, task/run state and outcome tracking.
dims.surfaces: In-process ClineCore.create/start/dispose and public SDK alias; HTTP/WebSocket hub for remote clients. UI packages/applications are separate.
dims.observability: Lifecycle/usage events and optional Langfuse/OTel. Compaction through plugin message builders has an explicitly documented instrumentation gap.

used_by: Cline CLI, desktop and IDE application hosts
key_insights: @cline/sdk is a one-line alias for core, not an independent engine.
Product release maturity should not be assigned to experimental 0.0.93 SDK APIs.
A plugin sandbox implemented with a worker/process is not evidence of OS confinement.

features_notes.durable_resume: SQLite persistence and restore; no per-effect journal/replay verified.
features_notes.os_sandbox: Unknown; plugin process isolation alone is insufficient evidence.
features_notes.worktrees: Checkpoint restore verified, dedicated worktree allocation not established.
features_notes.mcp_server: Client integration verified; server mode not established.

dims.context: Basic/agentic compaction with usage-aware request preparation; project rules, AGENTS.md, skills and workflow discovery.

dims.safety: Tool approvals and policy propagation; plugin worker/subprocess isolation is not an OS security sandbox.

features_notes.in_process_sdk: Available by adopting the separately public core/SDK layer.
features_notes.web_ui: Shared web UI/application components and IDE webviews; no separately deployed browser product established.

records.name: Kilo Code
records.one_liner: OpenCode-derived coding product with provider/runtime bridges, local server, task/worktree orchestration and optional Linux/macOS confinement; SDK launches/drives a server.

dims.loop: OpenCode-derived session processor plus extracted private core runner/coordinator; sessions serialize per key while different sessions overlap. V1 bridging paths remain.
dims.providers: Native @opencode-ai/llm support checks plus AI SDK 6 bridge; compatible endpoints and provider-specific usage/reasoning behavior.
dims.tools: Coding tools, resumable foreground/background task tool and MCP client with stdio/SSE/HTTP; file snapshots captured before streaming tool execution can begin.
dims.context: Token-pressure compaction and protected-recent-window result pruning; AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md discovery, SKILL.md and built-in plan policy.
dims.state: SQLite/Drizzle session, parent/workspace, permission, usage and revert metadata; coordinator drains recorded work. Full deterministic effect replay not established.
dims.safety: Permission rules and optional @kilocode/sandbox: Bubblewrap on Linux, Seatbelt on macOS; Windows unavailable. Unsupported requested profiles fail rather than silently weakening.
dims.extensibility: OpenCode-derived plugin hooks with Kilo adapters, skills, MCP and model/provider integration; current private core is not a supported public harness distribution.
dims.multi_agent: Resumable/background tasks, child sessions and managed Git worktree operations; no general workflow engine established.
dims.surfaces: CLI/TUI, IDE and web/application clients, ACP and local server. @kilocode/sdk createKilo starts kilo serve and returns a client. Private @opencode-ai/sdk-next instead embeds server routes behind in-memory fetch; it is unpublished.
dims.observability: Persisted token/cost/billing metadata plus optional OTLP logger/exporter and batch trace processor; absent endpoint gives an empty tracing layer.

used_by: Kilo CLI, VS Code and other first-party clients
key_insights: Current implementation explicitly declares OpenCode lineage; historical Cline/Roo association must not substitute for current source.
Public SDK is a server/process wrapper; a real in-process prototype exists in private @opencode-ai/sdk-next, so these are separate stability/distribution boundaries.
Optional confinement is real but platform-dependent and does not apply when no sandbox profile is selected.

features_notes.os_sandbox: Optional Linux Bubblewrap/macOS Seatbelt; Windows backend unavailable.
features_notes.in_process_sdk: Published @kilocode/sdk starts/drives a server; private @opencode-ai/sdk-next contains an in-process embedding prototype.
features_notes.durable_resume: Persistent session continuation; arbitrary effect replay not established.
features_notes.mcp_server: Client verified; server exposure not established.
features_notes.web_ui: Web UI components/IDE webviews and advertised cloud product; hosted deployment not inspected.

checked_claims: Public agents/core/SDK package boundaries and alias
Sequential/parallel tool scheduler and approval callback behavior
SQLite persistence and file checkpoint transactions
Kilo OpenCode fork declaration and subprocess SDK
Platform sandbox selection and explicit OTLP setup
Kilo private SDK-next in-process embedded route handler contrasted with published subprocess SDK
limitations: Static source review; no application, sandbox or recovery tests.
No inference from historical Kilo/Cline lineage; current source is authoritative.
Unverified surfaces are unknown, not assumed absent.
Cline experimental SDK maturity is separate from product maturity.
